raw='''1:1 2:1 3:1 4:1 5:1 6:1 ;:2 =:3 add:1 after:1 all:1 and:5 any:1 below:1 blue:4 box:7 boxes:4 brass:4 coin:4 color:4 completing:1 containing:3 contains:3 contents:2 currently:1 do:1 each:2 entire:2 exactly:1 final:1 format:1 glass:3 green:4 have:1 in:2 initially:1 into:3 key:4 label:2 labeled:2 labels:1 line:1 marble:3 move:3 moving:1 not:1 numbered:1 object:1 objects:1 of:3 on:1 one:1 operations:2 order:1 other:1 perform:1 red:5 replace:1 reply:1 report:1 shown:1 silver:4 six:2 swap:3 text:1 the:25 this:1 three:1 visible:2 with:2 without:1 you:1'''

'perform':'Perform the six numbered operations in order on the boxes',
